mentions.name: Cadenya
mentions.description: An agent runtime that connects to an existing API or MCP server, letting users wire a conversation UI directly to their API without the usual agent-building plumbing.
mentions.problem: The plumbing needed to build agents is overwhelming just to reach a hello-world state; the author simply wanted to connect a conversation UI to their API.
